articles.title: 剝智慧齒後鼻流黃膿鼻涕發臭！20歲男急求醫　證鼻竇炎急做手術
articles.summary: 一名男病人拔智慧齒後，鼻一直流黃膿，還有臭味，看醫生後證實患上鼻竇炎，要做手術治療。

levels.text: 一名男病人拔智慧齒後，鼻一直流出黃膿鼻涕，還有臭味。他去看醫生，陳醫生用內視鏡檢查，見到他右邊鼻竇不斷流出黃膿。醫生為他驗菌，又換藥，但病情沒有好轉。再做電腦斷層檢查後，發現右邊鼻竇塞滿膿液，拔牙的位置有一個骨頭缺口。陳醫生說，上排牙齒的根很接近鼻竇，拔牙可能令口腔和鼻竇之間穿了，細菌進去就會發炎。最後醫生為他做手術，開大鼻竇開口，清走膿液，讓鼻竇可以恢復正常功能。
levels.text_en: After a male patient had his wisdom tooth extracted, his nose kept discharging yellow pus with a bad smell. He went to see a doctor. Dr. Chen examined him with an endoscope and saw pus continuously flowing from his right sinus. The doctor took a sample to test for bacteria and changed his medication, but his condition did not improve. After a CT scan, they found his right sinus was completely filled with pus, and there was a bone defect at the site of the tooth extraction. Dr. Chen said the roots of the upper teeth are very close to the sinus, so extraction may create a hole connecting the mouth and sinus, allowing bacteria to enter and cause infection. Finally, the doctor performed surgery to widen the sinus opening and clear out the pus, allowing the sinus to return to normal function.

levels.text: 一名男病人拔智慧齒後，右邊鼻一直流出黃膿，而且有臭味。他去看醫生，情況都沒有改善。陳醫生為他做鼻竇內視鏡檢查，見到右邊鼻竇不斷流出黃膿，就抽取分泌物化驗細菌，再根據結果換藥，但病情依然沒有好轉。之後再安排電腦斷層掃描，發現他右邊的上頜竇塞滿了膿液，拔牙的位置也出現一個骨頭缺損。由於藥物治療效果不好，牙科檢查又顯示拔牙傷口已經癒合，沒有牙齒感染，陳醫生於是安排他做鼻竇內視鏡手術，擴大鼻竇的開口，將膿液引流出來並清洗乾淨，讓鼻竇恢復正常功能。陳醫生解釋，上排牙齒的牙根十分接近上頜竇，拔牙時有機會在口腔和鼻竇之間形成一個通道，細菌可以經這條通道進入鼻竇，造成「齒源性鼻竇炎」。這種情況通常只出現在一邊，如果曾經治療牙齒後，同一邊持續鼻塞、流黃膿鼻涕、有臭味，就要提高警覺，及早求醫。
levels.text_en: After a male patient had his wisdom tooth extracted, his right nostril kept discharging yellow pus with a foul smell. He went to see doctors, but his condition did not improve. Dr. Chen performed a sinus endoscopy and saw pus continuously flowing from his right sinus. He took a sample of the discharge to test for bacteria, then adjusted the medication based on the results, but the condition still did not improve. He then arranged a CT scan, which revealed that the patient's right maxillary sinus was filled with pus, and there was a bone defect at the site of the tooth extraction. Since medication was not effective, and a dental examination showed the extraction wound had healed with no tooth infection, Dr. Chen arranged for the patient to undergo sinus endoscopic surgery to widen the sinus opening, drain the pus, and clean it out, restoring normal sinus function. Dr. Chen explained that the roots of the upper teeth are very close to the maxillary sinus, so tooth extraction can create a passage between the mouth and sinus, allowing bacteria to enter the sinus through this passage and cause "odontogenic sinusitis" (sinusitis caused by a dental source). This condition usually occurs on only one side; if after dental treatment, persistent nasal blockage, yellow pus discharge, and foul smell occur on the same side, one should be alert and seek medical help early.

levels.text: 調整藥物都無改善 男病人接受鼻竇內視鏡檢查，陳醫生見到其右側鼻竇開口不斷有黃膿鼻涕流出，於是採集鼻腔分泌物進行細菌培養，依照檢查結果調整藥物，但治療後症狀沒有明顯改善。經進一步安排鼻竇電腦斷層檢查後，發現病人右側上頜竇完全塞滿膿液，在原本拔牙的位置可以看到上頜竇底部出現一處骨性缺損。 安排做手術 擴大鼻竇開口 由於藥物治療效果不佳，加上牙科評估拔牙傷口已經癒合，沒有發現牙齒感染源，陳醫生為病人安排做功能性鼻竇內視鏡手術，從鼻腔內擴大阻塞的鼻竇開口，把積在鼻竇內的膿液引流，同時沖洗乾淨，讓鼻竇恢復正常的通氣和引流功能。 為什麼拔上排牙齒，可能影響到鼻竇？ 陳醫生在帖文解釋 ，上排牙齒的牙根和上頜竇底部只有「一牆之隔」，部份人的牙根非常接近上頜竇，甚至向上突出到鼻竇底部，所以拔除上排臼齒或智慧齒時，有可能在口腔和上頜竇之間形成一個開口，稱為「口竇相通」。 形成齒源性鼻竇炎有2大原因 較小的開口有機會自行癒合，但如果開口沒有順利關閉，逐漸形成「一條持續存在的通道」，就稱為「口竇瘻管」，口腔內的細菌可能經由「這條通道」進入上顎竇，進一步造成「齒源性鼻竇炎」。陳醫生亦指，電腦斷層看到骨頭缺損，並不代表一定仍然存在「口竇瘻管」，仍需要牙科和口腔檢查才能確認，齒源性鼻竇炎主要有兩大原因： 每名患者處理方法不一 另外，齒源性鼻竇炎經常只發生在單側，假如上排牙齒曾經接受治療，後續又出現同一側鼻塞、黃膿鼻涕、鼻涕有臭味，或鼻子持續聞到臭味，就需要提高警覺。部份患者需要先處理牙齒感染，有些需要接受鼻竇手術，亦有情況必須同時處理牙齒和鼻竇，才能控制感染，降低復發機會。 （Facebook專頁「耳鼻喉科 陳世璽醫師」）
levels.text_en: Even after adjusting medication, there was no improvement. The male patient underwent a sinus endoscopy, and Dr. Chen observed pus continuously flowing from the opening of his right sinus. He therefore collected nasal secretions for bacterial culture and adjusted medication according to the results, but after treatment the symptoms showed no clear improvement. After further arranging a sinus CT scan, it was found that the patient's right maxillary sinus was completely filled with pus, and at the original tooth extraction site, a bony defect could be seen at the floor of the maxillary sinus. Arranging surgery to widen the sinus opening: Since medication was not effective, and dental assessment showed the extraction wound had healed with no source of tooth infection found, Dr. Chen arranged for the patient to undergo functional endoscopic sinus surgery, widening the blocked sinus opening from inside the nose, draining the pus accumulated in the sinus, and rinsing it clean, allowing the sinus to restore normal ventilation and drainage function. Why can extracting an upper tooth affect the sinus? Dr. Chen explained in his post that the roots of the upper teeth and the floor of the maxillary sinus are separated by only "a thin wall"; in some people, the tooth roots are extremely close to the maxillary sinus, even protruding upward into the sinus floor. So when extracting an upper molar or wisdom tooth, an opening may form between the mouth and the maxillary sinus, called an "oroantral communication." There are two main causes of odontogenic sinusitis: Smaller openings may heal on their own, but if the opening does not close properly and gradually forms "a persistent passage," it is called an "oroantral fistula." Bacteria in the mouth may enter the maxillary sinus through this passage, further causing "odontogenic sinusitis." Dr. Chen also noted that seeing a bone defect on CT does not necessarily mean an oroantral fistula still exists — dental and oral examination is still needed to confirm this. Odontogenic sinusitis mainly has two major causes. Treatment differs for each patient: In addition, odontogenic sinusitis usually occurs on only one side. If the upper teeth have previously received treatment, and afterward the same side develops nasal blockage, yellow pus discharge, foul-smelling mucus, or a persistent bad smell in the nose, one should be alert. Some patients need to have the dental infection treated first, some need sinus surgery, and in some cases both the teeth and sinus must be treated at the same time in order to control the infection and reduce the chance of recurrence. (Facebook page "ENT Doctor Chen Shixi")

Dr. Chen (an ENT doctor) shares the case to explain how tooth extraction can cause sinus infection.

articles.title: 【人事世界】跳槽真的比較容易成功嗎？ – Sydney HR的日與夜
articles.summary: 有研究指出，留在同一間公司做得耐，可能比跳槽更有好處。

levels.text: 很多人以為轉工可以加薪、升職，得到更好的發展。但有教授研究發現，留在同一間公司做得耐，也有好處。他研究了很多年，發現公司內部提升的員工，表現通常比新請的員工好。新請的員工人工雖然高，但要更長時間才適應新公司。所以，轉工未必一定比留低好。
levels.text_en: Many people think that switching jobs can bring a pay raise, a promotion, and better development. But a professor's research found that staying at the same company for a long time also has benefits. He studied this for many years and found that employees promoted from within a company usually perform better than newly hired employees. Although newly hired employees get higher pay, they need a longer time to adapt to the new company. So switching jobs is not necessarily better than staying put.

levels.text: 很多人認為，想加薪或升職，最快的方法就是轉工。但美國華頓商學院教授Matthew Bidwell在新書中指出，我們可能高估了轉工的好處，而低估了留在同一間公司發展的優勢。他花了二十多年研究員工在公司內部及公司之間流動的情況，發現工作年資越長的員工，越了解公司的運作和人際關係，這些經驗很難單靠一份履歷取代。他在2011年的研究發現，透過內部晉升的員工，工作表現通常比新聘請的員工好，而且離職率較低。不過，新聘請的員工起薪平均高出約18%。另一項研究指出，管理人員的晉升，大多是透過公司內部流動實現，而非靠轉工。因此，轉工雖然可以賺多一點錢，但未必代表事業有很大進步。
levels.text_en: Many people believe that the fastest way to get a raise or promotion is to switch jobs. But Matthew Bidwell, a professor at the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School, points out in his new book that we may overestimate the benefits of switching jobs while underestimating the advantages of staying and developing within the same company. He spent over twenty years studying how employees move within and between companies, and found that the longer an employee's tenure, the better they understand the company's operations and interpersonal relationships — experience that's hard to replace with just a resume. His 2011 study found that employees promoted internally usually perform better at work than newly hired employees, and have lower turnover rates. However, newly hired employees' starting salaries were on average about 18% higher. Another study found that most promotions to management positions happen through internal mobility rather than job switching. Therefore, while switching jobs may earn you a bit more money, it doesn't necessarily mean a big leap forward in your career.

levels.text: 相信大家都聽過，甚至親身經驗過，想加薪、想升職、 想改善自己的職業前景，最直接的方法就是跳槽。 尤其在競爭激烈的勞動市場， 員工往往認為與其留在原公司等待晉升， 不如到外面尋找更好的機會。一般來說，轉工可以爭取更高薪酬， 亦可以接觸不同的工作環境、累積經驗，甚至加快事業發展。 然而，美國賓夕法尼亞大學華頓商學院（Wharton School）管理學教授 Matthew Bidwell，最近在新書《The Insider Advantage》中提出一個值得重新思考的觀點： 我們可能高估了跳槽的好處， 卻低估了留在同一家公司長期發展所累積的優勢。 Bidwell 花了二十多年研究員工如何在企業內部及不同公司之間流動， 以及這些選擇對薪酬、工作表現和職業發展的影響。他認為， 一個人在公司工作得越久，便越了解企業的運作方式、文化、 人際網絡及內部決策程序。這些經驗和關係， 並非單靠一份履歷或過往工作經驗便可以取代。 當企業需要提拔人才擔任更重要的職位時，熟悉公司運作、 已經建立信任關係的內部員工，往往具有一定優勢。 他在2011年發表於《Administrative Science Quarterly》的研究， 分析美國一家金融服務公司投資銀行部門2003年至2009年的 員工資料，發現透過內部晉升取得職位的員工， 在新職位上首兩年的工作表現明顯較外聘員工好， 而且自願及非自願離職率亦較低。另一方面， 外聘員工的起薪平均高出約18%， 而且擁有較高的工作經驗及教育程度。研究亦發現， 外聘員工日後獲得晉升的速度反而較快。 這個結果反映一個有趣的現象：企業願意用較高薪酬吸引外來人才， 但較高的薪酬並不代表新員工可以立即發揮更好的工作表現。 外來人才即使具備豐富經驗，也需要時間了解新公司的文化、 工作流程、管理方式及人際關係。相反， 內部員工已經熟悉企業運作，能夠較快適應新職位的要求。 Bidwell 連同 Ethan Mollick 在2016年的另一項研究亦指出， 管理人員的職業發展及職責提升，較多是透過公司內部流動實現。 外部轉職雖然可以帶來薪酬增幅， 但不一定代表職級及責任同步提升。換句話說， 跳槽可能令你賺多一點錢，卻未必代表你在事業上向前走了一大步。 當然，這並不代表留在同一家公司就一定是最好的選擇。問題在於， 企業是否真的願意讓員工發展？員工是否有機會接觸新的工作、 接受培訓及承擔更大的責任？如果一個人已經在同一職位工作多年， 沒有晉升機會，管理層亦沒有清晰的職業發展安排， 那麼繼續留下來，未必是在累積優勢，也可能只是停滯不前。 近年的企業調查亦正好反映這個矛盾。Workday 在2026年10月公布的全球勞動力報告指出，57% 的受調查企業內部轉職數字按年下降， 而全球員工晉升率大致維持不變。 約一半受訪員工過去一年沒有嘗試內部轉職，其中27% 表示公司內
levels.text_en: I believe everyone has heard, or even personally experienced, that the most direct way to get a raise, a promotion, or improve one's career prospects is to job-hop. Especially in a fiercely competitive labor market, employees often feel that rather than staying at their current company waiting for promotion, it's better to look for better opportunities elsewhere. Generally speaking, switching jobs can secure higher pay, expose you to different work environments, help you accumulate experience, and even speed up career development. However, Matthew Bidwell, a management professor at the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School, recently proposed a perspective worth reconsidering in his new book 'The Insider Advantage': we may overestimate the benefits of job-hopping while underestimating the advantages accumulated from staying at the same company long-term. Bidwell spent over twenty years studying how employees move within companies and between different companies, and how these choices affect pay, job performance, and career development. He believes that the longer a person works at a company, the better they understand the company's operating methods, culture, interpersonal networks, and internal decision-making processes. This experience and these relationships cannot simply be replaced by a resume or past work experience. When companies need to promote talent into more important positions, internal employees who are familiar with company operations and have already built trust often have a certain advantage. His 2011 study, published in Administrative Science Quarterly, analyzed employee data from the investment banking division of a US financial services company from 2003 to 2009, and found that employees who obtained positions through internal promotion performed noticeably better in their first two years in the new role compared to externally hired employees, and also had lower voluntary and involuntary turnover rates. On the other hand, externally hired employees' starting salaries were on average about 18% higher, and they had more work experience and higher education levels. The study also found that externally hired employees were promoted faster afterward. This result reflects an interesting phenomenon: companies are willing to use higher salaries to attract outside talent, but higher pay doesn't mean new employees can immediately perform better at work. Even outside talent with rich experience needs time to understand the new company's culture, workflows, management style, and interpersonal relationships. In contrast, internal employees are already familiar with company operations and can adapt to new role requirements more quickly. Another study by Bidwell together with Ethan Mollick in 2016 also found that managers' career development and increases in responsibility are achieved more often through internal mobility within a company. While switching companies externally can bring a salary increase, it doesn't necessarily mean a simultaneous rise in rank and responsibility. In other words, job-hopping might earn you a bit more money, but it doesn't necessarily mean you've taken a big step forward in your career. Of course, this doesn't mean staying at the same company is always the best choice. The question is: is the company really willing to let employees develop? Do employees have the opportunity to try new work, receive training, and take on greater responsibility? If a person has been in the same position for many years with no promotion opportunities, and management has no clear career development plan, then continuing to stay may not be accumulating advantage — it might just be stagnation. Recent corporate surveys also reflect this contradiction. Workday's global workforce report, published in October 2026, found that 57% of surveyed companies saw year-on-year declines in internal transfer numbers, while the global employee promotion rate remained roughly unchanged. articles.title: 選委法律界當選　湯家驊冀下任特首有能力處理國家安全
articles.summary: 湯家驊喺選舉委員會法律界當選，佢話希望下任特首有能力處理國家安全等重要問題。

levels.text: 資深大律師湯家驊在選舉委員會法律界當選。他說，將代表香港人在特首選舉中投票，希望新特首有能力處理國家安全、社會福利和醫療等問題。他又說，現在評論李家超會否連任太早。他認為，北部都會區的發展和公屋問題都很重要。
levels.text_en: Senior counsel Tang Ka-piu was elected in the legal sector of the Election Committee. He said he will represent Hong Kong people in voting in the Chief Executive election, and hopes the new Chief Executive will be capable of handling issues such as national security, social welfare, and healthcare. He also said it is too early to comment on whether John Lee will seek re-election. He believes that development of the Northern Metropolis and the public housing issue are both very important.

levels.text: 湯家驊是行政會議成員，也是資深大律師。他在選舉委員會法律界的選舉中當選。他說會代表香港人投票選特首，希望新特首能處理好國家安全、社會福利和醫療等問題。有人問他是否支持李家超連任，他說現在說太早，因為還不知道李家超會不會參選。他又說，特首選舉有沒有競爭不重要，最重要是選出有能力的人。他認為下任特首最應該做的是發展北部都會區，因為這對香港經濟影響很大；另外他也希望公屋問題能有更大進展。
levels.text_en: Tang Ka-piu is a member of the Executive Council and a senior counsel. He was elected in the legal sector election of the Election Committee. He said he will represent Hong Kong people in voting for the Chief Executive, and hopes the new Chief Executive can properly handle issues such as national security, social welfare, and healthcare. When asked whether he supports John Lee's re-election, he said it's too early to say, since it's not yet known whether John Lee will run. He also said that whether there is competition in the Chief Executive election is not important — what matters most is electing someone capable. He believes the next Chief Executive's top priority should be developing the Northern Metropolis, as this will greatly affect Hong Kong's economy; he also hopes there will be greater progress on the public housing issue.

levels.text: 身兼行政會議成員的資深大律師湯家驊在選舉委員會界別分組選舉法律界當選。他表示，將代表香港人在特首選舉中投票，期望特首人選要有能力處理國家安全、社福及醫療等重要課題。 被問到是否支持行政長官李家超連任，湯家驊認為言之過早，因為不知道對方會否參選。至於特首選舉是否需要有競爭，他認為重點是選出合適的人，側重的是能力而非數目。 被問到下任特首有何優先處理事項，湯家驊認為，最重要是北部都會區的發展 ，因為將最直接影響香港經濟發展，亦希望在處理公屋問題上會有較大進展。
levels.text_en: Senior counsel Tang Ka-piu, who is also a member of the Executive Council, was elected in the legal sector constituency election of the Election Committee. He stated that he will represent Hong Kong people in voting in the Chief Executive election, and hopes the candidate chosen as Chief Executive will be capable of handling important issues such as national security, social welfare, and healthcare. Asked whether he supports Chief Executive John Lee's re-election, Tang said it would be premature to comment, since it is not known whether Lee will run. As for whether the Chief Executive election needs to have competition, he believes the key point is to elect the right person, with emphasis on ability rather than on the number of candidates. Asked what the next Chief Executive's priorities should be, Tang said the most important thing is the development of the Northern Metropolis, as it will most directly affect Hong Kong's economic development; he also hopes there will be greater progress in addressing the public housing issue.

articles.summary_en: Tang Ka-piu (湯家驊), a senior counsel and Executive Council member, has just been elected to represent the legal sector in Hong Kong's Election Committee, which will later vote for the next Chief Executive. Reporters asked him about his views on the next leader's priorities and on current Chief Executive John Lee's possible re-election.

articles.title: 南昌人氣Cafe禁無消費客　3人同行1人被勸離　市監局：涉強制低消
articles.summary: 南昌一間人氣咖啡店要求每人都要消費才可以坐下，令一位沒有點餐的女士被請離開，事件引起網民熱烈討論和政府部門關注。

levels.text: 在南昌一間人氣咖啡店，一位女士和兩位朋友一起去喝咖啡。朋友都買了咖啡，但她沒有想喝的，所以沒有點餐，只是坐在店裡等候。店方說每人入去都要自己消費，於是叫她離開。網民意見不同，有人說要消費才可以留下，有人說這樣太過分。政府部門說這間店的做法不對，要求它改正。
levels.text_en: At a popular cafe in Nanchang, a woman went to drink coffee with two friends. The friends both bought coffee, but she didn't want anything, so she didn't order and just sat in the shop waiting. The shop said everyone who enters must spend money themselves, so they told her to leave. Internet users had different opinions—some said you must spend money to stay, others said this was too much. A government department said the shop's practice was wrong and asked it to correct it.”},{

levels.text: 南昌一間人氣咖啡店實施「一人一消費」規則。一位女士和朋友去喝咖啡，因為沒有想喝的飲品而沒有點餐，之後被店員要求離開。店方解釋，裝修花了二十多萬人民幣，不是公益場所，所以要求每人都要消費才可以坐下。當地市場監管部門表示，這做法和星巴克不同，已經違反規定，要求店方拆除告示並作出改善。事件引起網民熱烈討論，有人支持店方的規則，也有人認為這樣太不合理。

3人同行僅1人未點單 網紅店「一客一消」惹議 據內地傳媒 《經視直播》 報道，事主日前與2名朋友前往南昌「A spoonful·一芍」咖啡店，其中2人先後點購咖啡，她因店內沒有想喝的飲品而沒有下單，僅坐在店內等候。她強調期間沒有拍照打卡或長時間霸佔座位，但店方仍要求每位進入院內者必須單獨消費，即使同行2人已經結賬，事主不消費便不能留下，最終被要求離店。事主認為，若是1人消費、多人長時間佔用座位，店家設限可以理解，但此次多數人已消費，自己只是短暫等候，對店方嚴格的規定表示難以接受。 店方稱斥資數十萬裝修 非公益場所 涉事店舖於11月18日回應，店內確實執行「一客一消」規則，要求每位進入院內者單獨消費。店方解釋，該店屬人氣打卡風格，投入了逾20萬人民幣（約23.5萬港元）打造院內景觀，並非公益場所，為避免未消費的客人佔用座位才訂立相關規定，並強調已透過招牌及口頭預先告知。店方補充，若通融處理容易惹來其他顧客不滿，故必須統一執行。 市監局介入：有別於星巴克做法 南昌市東湖區市場監督管理局大院分局同日回應指，該店的做法與星巴克（Starbucks）的「消費入座」不同。星巴克僅作模糊表述，而該店則明確要求人人消費方可入座，已涉嫌強制最低消費。分局於11月19日表示，經核實後認為店方的提示牌設置不妥，已要求摘除並督促整改。有內地律師指出，此做法或侵犯消費者的公平交易權，一經查實可被處罰。 事件曝光後，網民反應兩極。支持者認為「既然門口已有提示、店員也口頭告知了，不消費就沒必要進去了」、「做生意是兩廂情願的事情，如果接受不了不進去就好了」；反對者則質疑「逼迫消費也太離譜了」、「3人同行已有2人消費，難道要未點單者在路邊等候？」。目前店方稱會調整規則措辭，監管部門已督促整改。

A woman visiting with two friends didn't order because nothing appealed to her, and was asked to leave even though her friends had already bought drinks, sparking online debate and a government investigation.

articles.title: Porsche Raceborn 75 周年展覽  回顧品牌賽車史兼挑戰模擬賽車
articles.summary: Porsche嘅Raceborn 75周年賽車展喺灣仔舉行，等車迷睇歷史賽車同埋玩模擬賽車。

levels.text: Porsche嘅Raceborn賽車展覽在灣仔舉行，由十一月六日到三十日。一樓展出一架舊賽車，係影相嘅好地方。二樓用海報同模型，講返品牌以前嘅賽車故事，包括耐力賽同拉力賽。三樓可以試玩模擬賽車，計算圈速快慢。如果集齊咗印章，就可以去換一杯咖啡飲。十一月尾嗰兩日，仲會直播澳門嘅賽車比賽。
levels.text_en: Porsche's Raceborn car exhibition is being held in Wan Chai, from November 6 to 30. The first floor displays an old race car, which is a great place to take photos. The second floor uses posters and models to tell the story of the brand's past racing, including endurance races and rally races. On the third floor you can try a racing simulator, which calculates your lap time. If you collect all the stamps, you can exchange them for a cup of coffee. On the last two days of November, there will also be a live broadcast of the Macau racing competition.

levels.text: Porsche的賽車展覽Raceborn在香港舉行，地點是灣仔陳列室，展期由十一月六日到三十日。展覽分三層，一樓展示真實賽車997 GT3 RS 4.0，並設有拍照區。二樓用歷史海報和車模，介紹品牌參與過的耐力賽、拉力賽和Formula E賽事。三樓設有模擬賽車體驗，參加者可以試跑計時單圈。遊客在指定周末集齊印章，可以換取一杯免費咖啡。十一月二十一日和二十二日，陳列室會在二樓直播澳門格蘭披治大賽車。
levels.text_en: Porsche's car exhibition Raceborn is being held in Hong Kong, at the Wan Chai showroom, running from November 6 to 30. The exhibition is divided into three floors. The first floor displays the real race car, the 997 GT3 RS 4.0, and has a photo area. The second floor uses historical posters and car models to introduce the endurance races, rally races, and Formula E races the brand has participated in. The third floor has a racing simulator experience, where participants can try timed laps. Visitors who collect all the stamps on designated weekends can redeem a free cup of coffee. On November 21 and 22, the showroom will live broadcast the Macau Grand Prix on the second floor.

levels.text:
Porsche Raceborn 賽車運動 75 周年展覽來到香港，於 2026 年 11 月 6 日至 30 日在灣仔 Porsche 旗艦陳列室舉行。展覽橫跨 3 層，車迷可以近看 997 GT3 RS 4.0，也可以在模擬賽車挑戰中鬥單圈時間。

一樓展出 997 GT3 RS 4.0

Porsche Raceborn 在一樓展出 997 GT3 RS 4.0 和捷成車隊盃賽賽車，並設有賽車主題拍照區。香港站接續德國及北京展出，一樓看完實車，二樓便可透過歷史海報和車模回顧品牌參與過的賽事。

二樓回顧耐力賽、拉力賽和 Formula E

Porsche Raceborn 二樓展區以 4 個篇章回顧品牌賽車史。Porsche 於 1951 年憑 356 SL 在 Le Mans 24 小時耐力賽取得組別冠軍，其後曾 19 次奪得這項賽事的全場冠軍。公路賽篇章則展出 Targa Florio 和 Carrera Panamericana 泛美公路賽的歷史海報，以及 550 Spyder 和 911 Carrera RSR 車模。

拉力賽部分提到 911 在 1968 年至 1970 年連續 3 年贏得蒙地卡羅拉力賽（Monte Carlo Rally），以及 959 在 1986 年包辦巴黎－達卡拉力賽（Paris-Dakar Rally）冠亞軍。最後一章介紹客戶賽車 911 Cup，以及曾贏得 Formula E 車手、車隊及製造商世界冠軍的 99X Electric（GEN3 及 GEN3 Evo）。

三樓鬥單圈 指定周末集印章換咖啡

Porsche Raceborn 在三樓設有模擬賽車挑戰，車迷可試跑計時單圈，圈速會記在排行榜上。參加者可預先在網上登記或即場報名，周末在一樓接待處領取 Raceborn Passport，完成指定環節並集齊印章後，可到三樓 Raceborn Café 換領免費咖啡一杯。咖啡只在指定周末供應，數量有限。

展覽至 11 月 30 日 兩日直播澳門賽事

Porsche Raceborn 灣仔站展至 11 月 30 日，3 層展區結合實車、歷史展和模擬賽車。想在看展之餘看比賽，可留意 11 月 21 日及 22 日，陳列室會在二樓直播澳門格蘭披治大賽車的指定賽事。
levels.text_en:
The Porsche Raceborn 75th Anniversary of Motorsport exhibition has come to Hong Kong, held from November 6 to 30, 2026, at the Porsche flagship showroom in Wan Chai. The exhibition spans 3 floors; car fans can get a close look at the 997 GT3 RS 4.0, and also compete on lap times in a racing simulator challenge.

First floor: displaying the 997 GT3 RS 4.0

Porsche Raceborn displays the 997 GT3 RS 4.0 and the Carrera Cup race car on the first floor, and features a racing-themed photo area. The Hong Kong stop follows exhibitions in Germany and Beijing. After viewing the real cars on the first floor, visitors can go to the second floor to look back at the races the brand has participated in through historical posters and car models.

Second floor: looking back at endurance racing, rally racing, and Formula E

The second floor exhibition area of Porsche Raceborn reviews the brand's racing history in 4 chapters. In 1951, Porsche won a class championship at the Le Mans 24 Hours endurance race with the 356 SL, and subsequently won the overall championship of this race 19 times. The road racing chapter displays historical posters from the Targa Florio and the Carrera Panamericana road race, as well as models of the 550 Spyder and 911 Carrera RSR.

The rally section mentions that the 911 won the Monte Carlo Rally for 3 consecutive years from 1968 to 1970, and that the 959 took first and second place at the 1986 Paris-Dakar Rally. The final chapter introduces the customer race car 911 Cup, as well as the 99X Electric (GEN3 and GEN3 Evo), which has won the Formula E drivers', teams', and manufacturers' world championships.

Third floor: competing for the fastest lap; collect stamps on designated weekends to exchange for coffee

Porsche Raceborn has a racing simulator challenge on the third floor, where car fans can try timed laps, with lap times recorded on a leaderboard. Participants can register online in advance or sign up on the spot; on weekends they can collect a Raceborn Passport at the first-floor reception, and after completing the designated sections and collecting all the stamps, they can go to the Raceborn Café on the third floor to redeem a free cup of coffee. Coffee is only available on designated weekends, in limited quantities.

The exhibition runs until November 30; live broadcasts of the Macau race on two days

The Porsche Raceborn Wan Chai stop runs until November 30, with the 3-floor exhibition area combining real cars, a historical exhibit, and a racing simulator. For those who want to watch a race in addition to viewing the exhibition, note that on November 21 and 22, the showroom will live broadcast designated races of the Macau Grand Prix on the second floor.

articles.summary_en: This is a preview of a Porsche exhibition called "Raceborn" celebrating 75 years of Porsche motorsport, held at the Porsche showroom in Wan Chai, Hong Kong; it features real race cars, historical displays, and a sim racing challenge across three floors.

articles.title: 政府關注港鐵香港大學站接連信號故障　機電署初步指不涉鐵路安全
articles.summary: 港鐵香港大學站連續兩日信號故障，政府要港鐵查清楚原因同改善，機電工程署話初步同鐵路安全無關。

levels.text: 港鐵香港大學站兩日都有信號故障，令班次受影響。政府話佢哋好關注，要港鐵查清楚原因。政府仲要港鐵交齊報告同改善方法，以後唔好再有同樣嘅事。機電工程署已經派人去咗現場了解，初步話同鐵路安全無關。
levels.text_en: MTR's University station had signal faults for two days in a row, affecting train schedules. The government says it is very concerned and wants MTR to find out the cause clearly. The government also wants MTR to submit full reports and improvement measures, so that the same thing doesn't happen again. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has already sent people to the site to look into it, and preliminary findings say it's not related to rail safety.

levels.text: 港鐵香港大學站連續兩日發生信號故障，影響列車服務。政府表示關注，要求港鐵徹查事故原因，並提交詳細報告及改善措施，防止同類事件再發生。機電工程署已派員到現場調查，初步顯示事件與鐵路安全無關。
levels.text_en: MTR's University station experienced signal faults for two consecutive days, affecting train service. The government says it is concerned and is requiring MTR to thoroughly investigate the cause of the incident, and to submit a detailed report and improvement measures to prevent similar incidents from happening again. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has sent staff to the site to investigate; preliminary findings show the incident is not related to rail safety.

levels.text: 就港鐵香港大學站連續兩日出現信號設備故障，影響列車服務，政府發言人表示關注，已要求港鐵公司深入調查事故原因，並全面報告跟進工作和改善措施，以防止同類情況再次發生。 發言人說，機電工程署已派員前往事故現場了解有關情況及展開事故調查，初步顯示不涉及鐵路安全事宜。
levels.text_en: Regarding the signal equipment faults that occurred at MTR's University station for two consecutive days, affecting train service, a government spokesperson said the government is concerned and has requested that MTR Corporation conduct an in-depth investigation into the cause of the incident, and submit a comprehensive report on follow-up work and improvement measures, in order to prevent similar situations from happening again. The spokesperson said the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has sent staff to the incident site to understand the relevant situation and launch an investigation into the incident; preliminary findings indicate that it does not involve rail safety matters.

articles.title: 習近平：巴布政府堅守一個中國原則是順應歷史大勢的正義之舉
articles.summary: 習近平喺深圳見咗巴布亞新幾內亞總理馬拉佩，讚巴新堅持一個中國原則，仲話要同佢哋加強合作幫巴新發展。

levels.text: 習近平喺深圳見咗巴布亞新幾內亞嘅總理馬拉佩。他說巴新政府一直支持一個中國的原則，這是正確嘅做法。習近平仲話想同巴新一齊做大計劃，幫佢哋發展。雙方亦要共同保護環境，維護公平。馬拉佩都話巴新支持中國統一，想同中國做生意。
levels.text_en: Xi Jinping met Papua New Guinea's Prime Minister Marape in Shenzhen. He said PNG's government has always supported the One China principle, which is the correct thing to do. Xi also said he wants to work with PNG on big projects to help them develop. Both sides should also protect the environment together and uphold fairness. Marape said PNG supports China's reunification and wants to do business with China.

levels.text: 習近平在深圳會見到訪嘅巴布亞新幾內亞總理馬拉佩。習近平指出，巴新政府一直堅持一個中國原則，用實際行動支持中國維護領土完整和國家統一，呢是順應歷史潮流嘅正確做法。他又說，中國願意同巴新加強『一帶一路』和『聯通巴新』計劃嘅合作，幫助巴新發展，並喺應對氣候變化等方面加強合作。馬拉佩回應話，巴新建交五十年來一直堅定支持一個中國原則，亦支持中國統一，希望加強同中國嘅實務合作，歡迎中國企業到巴新投資。
levels.text_en: Xi Jinping met with visiting Papua New Guinea Prime Minister Marape in Shenzhen. Xi pointed out that PNG's government has consistently upheld the One China principle, supporting China's territorial integrity and national reunification through concrete actions, which is the correct approach in line with the trend of history. He also said China is willing to strengthen cooperation with PNG on the 'Belt and Road' and the 'Connect PNG' program, to help PNG's development, and to strengthen cooperation on things like climate change response. Marape responded that in the 50 years since establishing diplomatic relations, PNG has firmly supported the One China principle and also supports China's reunification, hoping to strengthen practical cooperation with China, and welcomes Chinese companies to invest in PNG.

levels.text: 國家主席習近平在深圳會見出席亞太經合組織領導人非正式會議的巴布亞新幾內亞總理馬拉佩。 習近平指出，巴新政府堅定恪守一個中國原則，以實際行動支持中國維護領土完整和國家統一，是順應歷史大勢的正義之舉。 習近平強調，中國願同巴新加強高質量共建「一帶一路」同「聯通巴新」計劃等戰略對接，深化合作，拓展合作新空間，幫助巴新實現可持續發展。雙方要加強多邊場合的相互協調，維護國際公平正義，拓展應對氣候變化、海洋環境保護等合作，維護全球南方共同利益。 新華社報道，馬拉佩表示，建交50年來，巴新始終恪守一個中國原則，堅定支持中國維護國家主權和領土完整，堅定支持中國實現國家統一、推進民族復興。巴新願同中方加強務實合作，歡迎中國企業赴巴新投資興業。
levels.text_en: State President Xi Jinping met in Shenzhen with Papua New Guinea Prime Minister Marape, who was attending the APEC Leaders' Informal Meeting. Xi pointed out that PNG's government firmly abides by the One China principle, supporting China's defense of its territorial integrity and national reunification through concrete actions, which is a just act in keeping with the great trend of history. Xi emphasized that China is willing to strengthen high-quality joint construction of the 'Belt and Road' with PNG's 'Connect PNG' program and other strategic alignments, deepen cooperation, expand new areas of cooperation, and help PNG achieve sustainable development. Both sides should strengthen mutual coordination in multilateral settings, uphold international fairness and justice, and expand cooperation on climate change response, marine environmental protection, and other areas, safeguarding the common interests of the Global South. According to Xinhua News Agency, Marape stated that in the 50 years since establishing diplomatic relations, PNG has always abided by the One China principle, firmly supporting China's efforts to safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity, and firmly supporting China's achievement of national reunification and advancement of national rejuvenation. PNG is willing to strengthen practical cooperation with China, and welcomes Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in PNG.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】日本人唱歌也被警方「關心」？
articles.summary: 警方喺灣仔一個日本人合唱團嘅免費音樂會度，突然話淨係俾受邀請嘅人入場，作者質疑警權是否太大。

levels.text: 大埔有教堂為喺火災死咗嘅人做彌撒，警方好似好「關心」。灣仔有一個日本人合唱團舉辦了一場免費音樂會，原本任何人都可以進場。但表演前一日，警方話唔俾公眾入去，淨係受邀請嘅人先至得入。他們所唱的歌曲與政治沒有關係，只是一些老歌而已。作者覺得警方好得閒，連咁嘅小事都要理。
levels.text_en: A church in Tai Po held a mass for people who died in the fire, and the police seem very 'concerned' about it. In Wan Chai, a Japanese choir held a free concert that was originally open to anyone. But the day before the performance, police said the public could not enter—only invited people could attend. The songs they sang had nothing to do with politics; they were just old songs. The author thinks the police have too much free time if they bother with such a small matter.

levels.text: 大埔有教堂為宏福苑火災死難者舉行追思彌撒，警方對此份外留意。上星期，灣仔一個教堂本來讓公眾免費參加日本人合唱團的音樂會，但演出前一天，警方卻要求主辦單位改為只准受邀人士入場。合唱團表示，過去多次都容許公眾參加，不明白這次為何被禁止。根據合唱團官網的通知，音樂會確實已改為邀請制，公眾不能進場。音樂會原定演唱的都是懷舊金曲，例如《龍貓》主題曲和《仙樂飄飄處處聞》裡的歌曲，與政治無關。作者質疑，警方連這種小事都要管，是否管得太多，甚至只是為了達到監管活動的指標。他認為，警方應該把心機放在跟進黃碧嬌的事件上，而不是浪費時間在這些無關痛癢的活動上。
levels.text_en: A church in Tai Po held a memorial mass for the victims of the Hung Fuk Court fire, and the police are paying extra attention to this. Last week, a church in Wan Chai originally allowed the public to attend a Japanese choir's concert for free, but the day before the performance, police required the organizers to change it so that only invited guests could attend. The choir said that in the past they had often allowed public attendance, and they don't understand why it was banned this time. According to a notice on the choir's official website, the concert was indeed changed to an invitation-only format, and the public cannot enter. The concert was originally scheduled to perform nostalgic classics, such as the theme song from 'My Neighbor Totoro' and songs from 'The Sound of Music,' which have nothing to do with politics. The author questions whether the police are managing even such trivial matters because they are overreaching, or perhaps just trying to meet a quota for regulating public events. He believes the police should focus their efforts on following up on the Wong Pik-kiu case instead of wasting time on these inconsequential events.

levels.text: 大埔教堂為宏福苑火災死難者辦追思彌撒，心虛的人自然份外「關心」，這一點我懂。但如果連日本人在灣仔教堂內唱老歌，也需要港警「詢問、關注」，那就恕我愚魯，實在看不透當中有何「責任」了。 昨天有讀者告知：「警方最近也『關心』許多其他公眾活動。上星期灣仔某教會內有一場日本人歌詠團表演，原本開放給公眾觀賞，沒有入場費，只需事先以電郵登記。但表演前一天，警方突然告之主辦單位不可讓公衆人士參加，只有獲主辦單位邀請的人才可入場。當日的曲目和主題都與政治敏感議題無關，主辦單位表示過往也曾多次容許公眾參與，不明白為什麼今次被禁。」 我沒法核實讀者說的每一句話，但翻查一下相關資料，事態的確有點不尋常。根據11月7日發布的宣傳貼文，「香港日本人合唱團」原定11月14日在灣仔循道衛理國際禮拜堂舉辦2026秋季音樂會（秋のコンサート2026），明言免費入場，不設劃位，只需掃QR code取電子門票就行（注1）。但現在瀏覽「香港日本人合唱團」官方網站，你會看到以下最新消息： 「2026年秋のコンサートについてお知らせいたします。事情により、本公演は招待制となりました。一般の方の当日入場はできません。」（注2）意思是：「謹此通知各位有關2026年秋季音樂會的安排。由於某些情況（事情により），本次演出已改為邀請制。一般公眾不能於演出當天入場。」 由此可知，音樂會由「公眾人士免費入場」改為「只准受邀者入場」，確有其事。至於具體原因，主辦單位似有難言之隱。留意日文「事情」跟中文不一樣，意思是「情況、原委、緣故」，通常指某件事發生的背景因素，有時甚至帶有「苦衷」意味。你看到「香港日本人合唱團」官網含含糊糊的寫「事情により」，就知道他們不便透露具體原因了。 如果真的有「不可抗力」禁止公眾入場，理據又是什麼呢？合唱團當日唱的，並非〈願榮光歸香港〉、〈Do You Hear the People Sing?〉之類的「禁歌」。根據音樂會海報，人家唱的都是老少咸宜的懷舊金曲，像宮崎駿《龍貓》主題曲、松田聖子的〈瑠璃色の地球〉、《仙樂飄飄處處聞》裏唱到街知巷聞的〈Do-Re-Mi〉等。在港日本人於禮拜堂內辦免費音樂會，難道警方又有「責任」去「關心」，甚至有權規管？ 若連這種芝麻綠豆的閒事也管，香港警察似乎好得閒。抑或只想透過這類「公眾活動」的管制次數來衝KPI？今日香港，大家已很難想像警權究竟有多大了。真希望警方能把「關心」天主教彌撒或日本人唱歌的多餘時間和精力，用來「關心」一下黃碧嬌，讓納稅人不會總覺得自己被依法打劫就好。 補記 本文發布後，另一位讀者傳來音樂會主辦委員會的英文電郵截圖，補充了一些細節。電郵在11月11日發出，即音樂會前三天，重點是說：委員會「與相關部門商討活動規例後（after consulting with relevant authorities regarding the regul
levels.text_en:
A church in Tai Po held a memorial mass for the victims of the Hung Fuk Court fire, and it's natural that people with guilty consciences would be especially 'concerned' about it—I understand that. But if even Japanese people singing old songs inside a Wan Chai church needs the Hong Kong police to 'inquire and pay attention,' then forgive my dullness, but I really cannot see what 'responsibility' is involved here.

Yesterday a reader told me: 'The police have recently also been "concerned" about many other public activities. Last week, a Japanese choir performance was held at a church in Wan Chai. It was originally open to the public to watch, with no admission fee, requiring only advance registration by email. But the day before the performance, the police suddenly informed the organizers that members of the public could not attend—only people invited by the organizer could enter. That day's program and theme had nothing to do with politically sensitive issues, and the organizer said they had allowed public participation many times before, and did not understand why it was banned this time.'

I cannot verify every word the reader said, but after checking the relevant information, the situation does indeed seem somewhat unusual. According to a promotional post published on November 7, the 'Hong Kong Japanese Choir' originally planned to hold its 2026 Autumn Concert (秋のコンサート2026) at the Wanchai Methodist International Church on November 14, explicitly stating free admission, no seat allocation, and that attendees only needed to scan a QR code to get an electronic ticket (note 1). But now, browsing the official website of the 'Hong Kong Japanese Choir,' you will see the following latest news: '2026年秋のコンサートについてお知らせいたします。事情により、本公演は招待制となりました。一般の方の当日入場はできません。' (note 2) Meaning: 'This is a notice regarding the arrangements for the 2026 Autumn Concert. Due to certain circumstances (事情により), this performance has been changed to an invitation-only format. The general public cannot enter on the day of the performance.'

From this we know that the concert being changed from 'free admission for the public' to 'invited guests only' is indeed true. As for the specific reason, the organizer seems to have some difficulty speaking openly about it. Note that the Japanese word '事情' is different from the Chinese word—it means 'circumstances, reasons, causes,' usually referring to the background factors behind something happening, and sometimes even carries a nuance of 'hidden difficulties.' When you see the 'Hong Kong Japanese Choir' official website vaguely writing '事情により,' you know they are not in a position to disclose the specific reason.

If there really is some 'force majeure' prohibiting public entry, what would the grounds even be? What the choir sang that day was not 'banned songs' like 'Glory to Hong Kong' or 'Do You Hear the People Sing?' According to the concert poster, what they performed were all nostalgic classics suitable for all ages, such as the theme song from Miyazaki's 'My Neighbor Totoro,' Matsuda Seiko's 'Ruriiro no Chikyuu,' and the widely known 'Do-Re-Mi' from 'The Sound of Music.' Japanese residents in Hong Kong holding a free concert inside a chapel—does the police really have a 'responsibility' to be 'concerned' about this, or even the authority to regulate it?

If even such trivial, sesame-seed-sized matters need to be managed, the Hong Kong police seem to have a lot of free time. Or do they just want to boost their KPI through the number of times they control this kind of 'public activity'? In today's Hong Kong, it has become very hard to imagine just how extensive police power really is. I truly hope the police could redirect the excess time and energy they spend 'being concerned' about Catholic masses or Japanese people singing, toward 'being concerned' about Wong Pik-kiu instead, so that taxpayers won't always feel like they're being robbed under the cover of law.

Postscript: After this article was published, another reader sent a screenshot of an English email from the concert's organizing committee, adding some details. The email was sent on November 11, three days before the concert, and the main point was that the committee, 'after consulting with relevant authorities regarding the regul...' [text cuts off here]

The author questions why police would bother restricting access to a choir concert of old, politically harmless songs.

articles.title: 港人有樣睇？小紅書列「港人骨子裏4大特質」讚：恰到好處的體面
articles.summary: 內地有人喺小紅書話香港人有四大特質，包括中英夾雜、有禮貌但有分寸、做嘢快、活得現實又勵志。

levels.text: 小紅書有人寫咗一篇文，話香港人骨子裡有四大特質。佢話香港人講嘢中英夾雜，係因為兩文三語環境長大。他說香港人有禮貌，但唔會問太多，形容為恰到好處嘅體面。香港人做嘢快，排隊好準時，因為時間是生存空間。佢又講李嘉誠細個出嚟做嘢嘅故事，話香港人尊重專業，面子係虛嘅，搞掂先至係真本事。
levels.text_en: Someone on Xiaohongshu wrote an article saying Hong Kong people have four major traits. He said Hong Kong people mix Chinese and English when speaking because they grew up in an environment of two written languages and three spoken languages. He said Hong Kong people are polite but don't ask too many questions, describing this as "just the right amount of dignity." Hong Kong people work fast and queue punctually, because time is living space. He also told the story of Li Ka-shing going out to work from a young age, saying Hong Kong people respect professionalism — face is empty, getting things done is the real skill.

levels.text: 有內地博主在小紅書發文，說香港人有四個特質：說話中英夾雜、有禮貌但有分寸、做事效率高、活得現實又勵志。她認為香港人在兩文三語環境長大，講話直接只是因為時間寶貴。她又說香港人禮貌中帶分寸，例如幫人開門會說謝謝，但不會多問。香港人走路快、排隊準時，是因為這城市令他們明白時間就是生存空間。她又提到李嘉誠十四歲輟學養家，後來白手起家的故事，指香港人尊重專業，看重實力多過面子。博主又說，香港「樓價高、節奏快、國際化」逼出了這些特質。現時香港人口約有七百五十二萬人。
levels.text_en: A mainland blogger posted on Xiaohongshu saying Hong Kong people have four traits: mixing Chinese and English when speaking, being polite but with boundaries, high efficiency in doing things, and living realistically while also living out an inspiring story. She believes Hong Kong people grow up in an environment of two written languages and three spoken languages, and that they speak directly simply because time is precious. She also said Hong Kong people are polite but with boundaries — for example, someone will say thank you if you hold a door open for them, but won't ask many questions beyond that. Hong Kong people walk fast and queue punctually, because the city has taught them that time equals living space. She also mentioned the story of Li Ka-shing dropping out of school at 14 to support his family, later building himself up from nothing, saying Hong Kong people respect professional ability and value real strength over face. The blogger also said Hong Kong's "high property prices, fast pace, and internationalization" force these traits into being. Hong Kong's current population is about 7.52 million.

levels.text: 小紅書博主列舉「港人骨子裏4大特質」 該內地博主在小紅書帳號以「冷知識！在香港長大的人一眼就能看出來」為題發帖，片中表示她常駐香港和大灣區，留意到「刻在港人骨子裏的4大特質」，分別為「說話中英夾雜」、「有禮貌，但更有邊界感」、「高效率」、「活得現實，也活出傳奇」。 說話中英夾雜 樓主指，由於港人自小在兩文三語環境下長大，因此談話時能在三語之間無縫切換，理解港人的直接，「他不是不客氣，時間確實太珍貴，沒空繞彎子」。 有禮貌，但更有邊界感 樓主表示「Sorry」、「不好意思」是港人的口頭禪，欣賞港人既禮貌亦有分寸，舉例如別人幫忙拉門會說謝謝，但不會詢問去哪裏，形容這種「恰到好處的體面」使擁擠的城市既有序又自在，並稱「熱情是自選動作，尊重是必選動作」。 高效率 香港人愛排隊？樓主稱，排隊和守時是本能，港人走路、說話、做事快並非性格急，而是城市教會他們時間不是金錢，是生存空間，「每一步都要算回報率，每一秒都要有產出」。 活得現實，也活出傳奇 樓主認為香港孩子普遍早熟，中學開始規劃履歷，大學不再是討論夢想，而是關心未來職業和理想薪酬，指出「抗壓是必備技能，尋找出路則是生存技能」。她又以李嘉誠14歲輟學養家為例，提到他到茶樓當侍應、鐘錶店當學徒，以及靠塑膠花廠起家的故事，指出在香港白手起家不是神話而是現實，稱港人尊重專業，更崇拜從零打拼的故事，「面子是虛的，搞定一切才是真實力」。 香港「高房價、快節奏、國際化」迫出港人特質 該博主在片尾總結，指在香港這座有近750萬人的城市裏，港人特質其實是用「高房價、快節奏、國際化」逼出來的「最佳生存方案」，形容「它不溫暖但有效，不輕鬆但非常公平」。 2026年年中香港人口約為752萬人 而根據香港政府統計處於2026年8月中發表的數字顯示，2026年年中香港人口的臨時數字約為752萬人，與2025年比較增加1.9萬人，升幅0.3%，和博主所言數據相若。 （ 小紅書 ）
levels.text_en:
A Xiaohongshu blogger lists "4 major traits ingrained in Hong Kong people." The mainland blogger posted on her Xiaohongshu account under the title "Fun fact! You can tell at a glance who grew up in Hong Kong," saying in the video that she is based between Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area, and has noticed "4 traits ingrained in Hong Kong people's bones": "mixing Chinese and English when speaking," "polite, but with an even stronger sense of boundaries," "high efficiency," and "living realistically, while also living out a legend."

Mixing Chinese and English when speaking
The poster says that because Hong Kong people grow up from childhood in an environment of two written languages and three spoken languages, they can switch seamlessly between the three languages in conversation. She asks people to understand Hong Kong people's directness: "It's not that they're rude — time really is too precious, there's no time to beat around the bush."

Polite, but with an even stronger sense of boundaries
The poster says "Sorry" and "excuse me" are catchphrases of Hong Kong people. She admires that Hong Kong people are both polite and have boundaries — for example, if someone holds a door for you, you say thank you, but they won't ask where you're going. She describes this as "just the right amount of dignity," which makes a crowded city both orderly and comfortable, saying "warmth is optional, but respect is mandatory."

High efficiency
Do Hong Kong people love queuing? The poster says queuing and punctuality are instinctive. Hong Kong people walk, talk, and work fast not because they are impatient by nature, but because the city has taught them that time isn't money — it's living space. "Every step must be calculated for return, every second must produce something."

Living realistically, while also living out a legend
The poster believes Hong Kong children generally mature early — planning their resumes from secondary school, and by university no longer discussing dreams but instead focusing on future careers and desired salaries. She says "withstanding pressure is an essential skill, and finding a way out is a survival skill." She cites Li Ka-shing, who dropped out of school at 14 to support his family, worked as a waiter in a teahouse, an apprentice in a watch shop, and eventually built his fortune starting with a plastic flower factory, as an example that in Hong Kong, building yourself up from nothing is not a myth but a reality. She says Hong Kong people respect professionalism and admire stories of starting from zero even more, saying "face is empty — getting everything done is real strength."

Hong Kong's "high property prices, fast pace, and internationalization" force out these traits
At the end of the video, the blogger concludes that in a city of nearly 7.5 million people like Hong Kong, these traits are actually the "best survival solution" forced out by "high property prices, fast pace, and internationalization," describing it as "not warm, but effective; not easy, but very fair."

Mid-2026 Hong Kong population about 7.52 million
According to figures released by the Hong Kong Census and Statistics Department in mid-August 2026, the provisional mid-2026 population figure is about 7.52 million, an increase of 19,000 compared to 2025, a rise of 0.3%, similar to the figure cited by the blogger. (Xiaohongshu)

articles.summary_en: A mainland Chinese blogger posted on Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) claiming Hong Kong people share four core traits, using examples like Li Ka-shing's rags-to-riches story to illustrate Hong Kong's culture of efficiency and pragmatism. The article reports on this viral post and checks its population claims against official statistics.

articles.title: 【電影大道】《媽樣年華》 學在愛裏不丟失自己 今日對阿媽要求更高？男觀眾在女性電影找到共鳴嗎？何謂愛自己？專訪導演胡翠兒、監製陳心遙
articles.summary: 呢套戲講一個四十幾歲嘅媽媽偷偷學跳鋼管舞，搵返一樣淨係為咗自己嘅嘢做。

levels.text: 電影《媽樣年華》係講一個四十幾歲嘅媽媽，偷偷學跳鋼管舞。佢不是為咗丈夫，也不是為咗仔女，只是為自己。導演胡翠兒同監製陳心遙話，呢個係所有人的故事。我哋因為愛情、工作、家庭，而忘記咗自己。你有幾耐冇為自己做一件事？陳心遙講，如果觀眾睇完戲會諗一諗，噉就係呢套戲嘅意義了。
levels.text_en: The film 'Mama's Dance' is about a mother in her forties who secretly learns pole dancing. She doesn't do it for her husband or her children, only for herself. Director Wu Chui-yi and producer Chan Sum-yiu say this is everyone's story — because of love, work, and family, we forget ourselves. How long has it been since you did something just for yourself? Chan Sum-yiu says if the audience thinks about this after watching the film, that is the meaning of the movie.

levels.text: 電影《媽樣年華》講一個四十幾歲的媽媽，偷偷學跳鋼管舞的故事。她不是為了丈夫，也不是為了孩子，只是為了自己。導演胡翠兒和監製陳心遙一起填了電影主題曲《後青春舞曲》的歌詞。這套戲表面上是講媽媽，其實是講每一個人。很多人為了愛情、工作、家庭，漸漸忘記了自己。如果放下這些身份，你會想做甚麼？你有多久沒有只為自己做過一件事？現在社會對媽媽的要求越來越高，又要有興趣，又要有全職工作。這些問題沒有標準答案。陳心遙說，如果觀眾看完電影後會思考或討論，這就是電影的意義。
levels.text_en: The film 'Mama's Dance' tells the story of a mother in her forties who secretly learns pole dancing. She doesn't do it for her husband or for her children, only for herself. Director Wu Chui-yi and producer Chan Sum-yiu together wrote the lyrics for the film's theme song 'Post-Youth Dance Tune'. On the surface the film is about a mother, but it's really about everyone. Many people gradually forget themselves because of love, work, and family. If you set aside these identities, what would you want to do? How long has it been since you did something purely for yourself? Nowadays society's demands on mothers keep rising — they must have hobbies and also hold full-time jobs. These questions have no standard answers. Chan Sum-yiu says if audiences think or discuss this after watching the film, that is the meaning of the movie.

levels.text:
「如能重演一次，我演我自己，用盡力呼吸放肆自轉」電影《媽樣年華》主題曲「後青春舞曲」由導演胡翠兒和監製陳心遙填詞。電影講一個四十幾歲媽媽偷學鋼管舞的故事，終於，不為丈夫兒子或母親，只為自己，做一件事。

看似是女性／媽媽的故事，但其實是所有人的故事。每個人都可能為了戀愛、工作、家庭、責任，而忘記自己。若卸下這一切角色與面具，你喜歡做甚麼，你多久沒有只為了自己做一件事？若果我熱愛的就是我的工作，我的家人，我的戀人，那我算不算已經是為了自己而活？現今社會要求媽媽還要有一個興趣，或要有一份全職工作，其實會不會是更加苛刻？

或者以上都沒有絕對答案，但「如果可以引起觀眾看戲後思考或討論，就是電影的其中一個意義了。」監製陳心遙說。

levels.text_en:
"If I could live it again, I'd play myself, breathing with all my strength, spinning freely" — the theme song of the film 'Mama's Dance', 'Post-Youth Dance Tune', was written by director Wu Chui-yi and producer Chan Sum-yiu. The film tells the story of a mother in her forties secretly learning pole dancing — finally doing something not for her husband, son, or mother, but only for herself.

It looks like a story about women/mothers, but it's actually everyone's story. Everyone may forget themselves because of romance, work, family, and responsibilities. If you cast off all these roles and masks, what do you like to do, and how long has it been since you did something just for yourself? If what I love is my work, my family, my partner — does that count as already living for myself? Nowadays society demands that mothers also have a hobby or a full-time job — isn't that even more harsh?

Perhaps none of these have absolute answers, but "if it can make the audience think or discuss after watching the film, that is one of the meanings of the movie," says producer Chan Sum-yiu.

levels.text: NVIDIA嘅創辦人黃仁勳即時辭去總裁同CEO職位，他已經做咗33年老闆。董事會而家搵財務總監 Colette Kress 暫代CEO，她同時仍然兼任財務總監。黃仁勳最近有緋聞同調查傳聞，但公司冇講明係唔係辭職原因。股價一度跌咗一成，不過11月17日嘅業績照常公布。
levels.text_en: NVIDIA's founder Jensen Huang has immediately resigned as President and CEO, after being the boss for 33 years. The board has now found CFO Colette Kress to serve as interim CEO, while she still also holds the CFO role. Jensen Huang has recently been linked to scandal and rumors of investigation, but the company has not said whether this is the reason for his resignation. The stock price once dropped by 10%, but the November 17 earnings report will be released as scheduled.

levels.text: NVIDIA創辦人黃仁勳在美國時間11月12日宣布，即時辭去總裁、行政總裁及董事會成員職務，結束長達33年的領導生涯。董事會委任財務總監Colette Kress暫代行政總裁，並同時兼任財務總監，直至選出正式繼任人為止。公司又首次設立董事會主席一職，由Harvey C. Jones出任，他曾任Synopsys行政總裁，有豐富企業管理經驗。黃仁勳近期捲入婚外情及可能涉及外國情報活動的報道，董事會早前已就此展開獨立調查，但最新公告沒有說明辭職是否與調查有關。消息公布後，NVIDIA股價一度在盤前下跌超過一成，不過公司確認11月17日的季度業績將如期公布。
levels.text_en: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang announced on November 12 (US time) that he is immediately resigning from his roles as President, CEO, and board member, ending a leadership career spanning 33 years. The board has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and she will continue to also serve as CFO, until a permanent successor is chosen. The company is also establishing a board chair position for the first time, with Harvey C. Jones taking the role; he previously served as CEO of Synopsys and has extensive corporate management experience. Jensen Huang has recently been caught up in reports of an extramarital affair and possible involvement in foreign intelligence activities, and the board had earlier launched an independent investigation into this, but the latest announcement does not clarify whether the resignation is related to the investigation. Following the announcement, NVIDIA's stock price fell more than 10% in pre-market trading at one point, but the company confirmed that the quarterly earnings report on November 17 will be released as scheduled.

levels.text:
美國 AI 晶片巨頭 NVIDIA（英偉達）於美國時間 11 月 12 日正式宣布，創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）即時辭去公司總裁、行政總裁及董事會成員職務，結束其長達 33 年的掌舵生涯。董事會同時任命現任執行副總裁兼財務總監 Colette Kress 出任臨時行政總裁，並啟動正式繼任人選的遴選程序。

▲NVIDIA 官方公佈

Colette Kress 兼任 CEO 及 CFO　董事會尋找正式接班人

NVIDIA 在官方聲明中確認，Colette Kress 將在過渡期間同時擔任臨時行政總裁、執行副總裁及財務總監，直至董事會選出正式繼任者。公司將同時考慮內部及外部候選人，目前未公布完成遴選的時間表。

Kress 於 2013 年 9 月加入 NVIDIA，至今任職超過 13 年，曾協助公司由遊戲圖像晶片供應商發展為全球主要 AI 運算平台企業。加入 NVIDIA 前，她曾在 Microsoft 及 Cisco 等科技企業擔任財務管理職位，累積近 25 年相關經驗。

NVIDIA 首設董事會主席　承諾業務不受影響

董事會同時任命 Harvey C. Jones 為公司首任董事會主席。Jones 曾擔任 Synopsys 行政總裁及執行主席，擁有超過 30 年科技企業管理與投資經驗。

Jones 表示，Kress 熟悉 NVIDIA 的客戶、營運、財務狀況及技術發展方向，董事會對她及現有管理團隊充滿信心，預期公司營運、客戶承諾及產品路線圖不會因人事變動而中斷。Kress 則表示，將在黃仁勳過去 33 年建立的基礎上，繼續推動 NVIDIA 在加速運算及人工智能領域的發展。

黃仁勳捲入婚外情及間諜風波　董事會早前啟動調查

黃仁勳近期捲入多宗爭議。《紐約時報》及其他外媒先後報道，他與前 Megaspeed 高層黃樂（Alice Huang）有婚外情，而美國情報部門懷疑黃樂與中國情報機構有關。其後再有報道指，黃仁勳曾與 NVIDIA 醫療業務副總裁 Kimberly Powell 發展關係。相關指控涉及的情報疑慮目前尚未有公開調查結論。

NVIDIA 董事會於 11 月 8 日宣布就外國情報活動相關報道展開獨立調查，並於 11 月 10 日公布由外部法律顧問協助調查。董事會當時強調，沒有理由相信美國國家安全或 NVIDIA 的商業機密已遭洩露。

NVIDIA 最新的行政總裁交接公告並未直接說明黃仁勳辭職的原因，也沒有公布調查結論，因此目前不能確認上述爭議是否構成辭任的正式原因。

股價盤前下跌　11 月 17 日財報安排不變

隨着黃仁勳去留問題發酵，NVIDIA 股價連日受壓。路透社報道，正式辭任消息公布後，公司股價在美股盤前交易一度下跌逾 10%，市場關注領導層變動會否影響 NVIDIA 與大型 AI 客戶的合作，以及未來產品發展策略。

NVIDIA 已確認，原定於美國時間 11 月 17 日公布的 2027 財政年度第三季業績將如期發表，業績電話會議安排亦維持不變。這將是黃仁勳離任後，公司管理層首次面對的重要季度業績發布。
levels.text_en:
US AI chip giant NVIDIA officially announced on November 12 (US time) that founder Jensen Huang is immediately resigning from his positions as President, CEO, and board member, ending his 33-year tenure at the helm. The board has simultaneously appointed current Executive Vice President and CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and has launched a formal process to select a permanent successor.

▲NVIDIA official announcement

Colette Kress to hold both CEO and CFO roles; board searching for permanent successor

In its official statement, NVIDIA confirmed that Colette Kress will serve concurrently as interim CEO, Executive Vice President, and CFO during the transition period, until the board selects a permanent successor. The company will consider both internal and external candidates, and has not yet announced a timeline for completing the selection process.

Kress joined NVIDIA in September 2013, and has worked there for over 13 years, having helped the company grow from a gaming graphics chip supplier into a leading global AI computing platform company. Before joining NVIDIA, she held financial management positions at tech companies including Microsoft and Cisco, accumulating nearly 25 years of related experience.

NVIDIA establishes board chair position for first time; promises business will not be affected

The board has also appointed Harvey C. Jones as the company's first-ever board chair. Jones previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys, with over 30 years of experience in tech company management and investment.

Jones said that Kress is deeply familiar with NVIDIA's customers, operations, financial condition, and technology direction, and that the board has full confidence in her and the existing management team. He expects that the company's operations, customer commitments, and product roadmap will not be disrupted by this personnel change. Kress, for her part, said she will continue building on the foundation Jensen Huang established over the past 33 years, driving NVIDIA's development in accelerated computing and artificial intelligence.

Jensen Huang embroiled in affair and espionage controversy; board had earlier launched investigation

Jensen Huang has recently been involved in multiple controversies. The New York Times and other foreign media outlets reported that he had an extramarital affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, and that US intelligence agencies suspect Alice Huang may have ties to Chinese intelligence agencies. Subsequent reports further indicated that Jensen Huang had also developed a relationship with Kimberly Powell, Vice President of NVIDIA's healthcare business. There is currently no public conclusion to the investigation regarding the intelligence concerns involved in these allegations.

NVIDIA's board announced on November 8 that it was launching an independent investigation into reports related to foreign intelligence activities, and on November 10 announced that external legal counsel would assist with the investigation. At the time, the board emphasized that there was no reason to believe that US national security or NVIDIA's trade secrets had been compromised.

NVIDIA's latest announcement on the CEO transition does not directly explain the reason for Jensen Huang's resignation, nor does it disclose the investigation's conclusions, so it cannot currently be confirmed whether the above controversies constitute the formal reason for his resignation.

Stock falls in pre-market trading; November 17 earnings report unaffected

As questions over Jensen Huang's position developed, NVIDIA's stock price has been under pressure for several days. Reuters reported that after the resignation announcement, the company's stock fell more than 10% at one point in US pre-market trading, with the market concerned about whether the leadership change would affect NVIDIA's cooperation with major AI clients, as well as future product development strategy.

NVIDIA has confirmed that its fiscal year 2027 third-quarter earnings report, originally scheduled for release on November 17 (US time), will be published as planned, and the arrangements for the earnings conference call will also remain unchanged. This will be the first major quarterly earnings release faced by the company's management since Jensen Huang's departure.

articles.summary_en: This is a news report about NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang suddenly resigning as CEO after 33 years, amid scandal rumors, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. The article covers the leadership change, the appointment of a new board chair, the swirling controversy, and the stock market reaction.

articles.title: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數增至20萬人　多於預期
articles.summary: 美國上星期申請失業救濟嘅人多咗，去到20萬人，多過大家估計。

levels.text: 美國上個星期申請失業救濟嘅人增加到20萬，多過大家估嘅。比上個星期多9000人。呢兩個月淨係有兩個星期有20萬人咁多。4個星期平均都有19.5萬人。到10月31日，仲喺度攞緊救濟嘅人少咗，得返169.7萬人，比上個星期少2萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week, the number of people in the US applying for unemployment benefits increased to 200,000, more than what everyone estimated. That's 9,000 more than the previous week. In the past two months, only two weeks have had as many as 200,000 people. The 4-week average is also 195,000 people. As of October 31, the number of people still receiving benefits decreased, down to only 1.697 million people, 20,000 fewer than the previous week.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

levels.text: 上星期美國申請失業救濟的人數上升到20萬，比大家預期的多。這個數字比前一星期多9000人。過去兩個月，只有兩星期的人數達到20萬。4星期平均數字超過19.5萬人。另外，到10月31日為止，仍在領取救濟金的人減少到169.7萬，比之前少了2萬人。
levels.text_en: Last week, the number of people applying for unemployment benefits in the US rose to 200,000, more than everyone expected. This figure is 9,000 more than the previous week. In the past two months, only two weeks have reached a number of 200,000. The 4-week average figure exceeds 195,000 people. Additionally, as of October 31, the number of people still receiving benefits decreased to 1.697 million, 20,000 fewer than before.

levels.text: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數增至20萬人，多於預期，按星期增加9000人，近兩個月只有兩星期達到20萬人水平。 4星期平均值維持於逾19.5萬人。 截至10月31日止，該星期持續申領失業救濟人數減至169.7萬人，按星期減少2萬人。
levels.text_en: The number of new weekly unemployment benefit claims in the US rose to 200,000 last week, higher than expected, an increase of 9,000 week-over-week. In nearly the past two months, only two weeks have reached the 200,000 level. The 4-week average remains above 195,000. As of the week ending October 31, the number of continuing unemployment benefit claims decreased to 1.697 million, down 20,000 week-over-week.

articles.title: 北部都會區金融諮詢工作小組開會　討論北都大學城可行融資安排
articles.summary: 金管局同銀行公會一齊開會，傾北部都會區點樣用錢同埋大學城嘅發展計劃。

levels.text: 金管局同銀行公會開咗個會，傾北部都會區嘅錢點樣用。佢哋話想幫啲大學同園區借錢更容易，仲會教局講北都大學城嘅新計劃。銀行話會幫手支持呢個大學城同埋附近嘅地方一齊發展。
levels.text_en: The Monetary Authority and the Banking Association held a meeting to discuss how money for the Northern Metropolis should be used. They said they want to make it easier for universities and parks to borrow money, and also had the Education Bureau present the new plans for the Northern Metropolis University Town. The banks said they would help support the development of the university town together with the nearby areas.

levels.text: 金管局與銀行公會共同舉行會議，討論北部都會區的融資安排。他們建議修改規則，把部分大學及園區公司列為「本地公營單位」，這樣可以降低銀行的資金成本，令這些機構更容易取得銀行貸款。教育局亦在會上介紹了北都大學城的最新發展，包括大學城的定位、校園規劃及財務安排。與會的銀行代表表示，未來會提供合適的金融服務，支持大學城與鄰近產業園區一同發展。
levels.text_en: The Monetary Authority and the Banking Association jointly held a meeting to discuss financing arrangements for the Northern Metropolis. They proposed amending the rules to classify some universities and park companies as 'local public sector entities', which would lower banks' cost of funds and make it easier for these institutions to obtain bank loans. The Education Bureau also presented the latest developments on the Northern Metropolis University Town at the meeting, including the university town's positioning, campus planning, and financial arrangements. Bank representatives attending said they would provide suitable financial services in the future to support the joint development of the university town and nearby industrial parks.

levels.text: 金管局與銀行公會共同成立的「北部都會區金融諮詢工作小組」舉行第3次會議。發展局、教育局、財經事務及庫務局、創新科技及工業局，以及25間參與工作小組的銀行代表均有出席。 金管局為進一步加強銀行業對北都項目的融資支持，建議修訂《銀行業（資本）規則》，指定包括11間專上院校及3間園區公司的政府關聯機構為「本地公營單位」，有助降低銀行資金成本，促進相關機構獲取銀行融資，以加速落實北都項目。金管局擬於明年首季向立法會提交有關修訂案，以期第2季生效。 教育局在會議上介紹了北都大學城最新發展，包括3個大學城定位、校園區發展及相關財務安排。 與會者就北都大學城的可行融資安排，例如貸款及公私營合作等，進行討論及提供專業建議。工作小組參與銀行表示，將提供合適金融服務，支持北都大學城與周邊產業園區及項目協同發展。
levels.text_en: The 'Northern Metropolis Financial Advisory Working Group', jointly established by the Monetary Authority and the Banking Association, held its 3rd meeting. Representatives from the Development Bureau, Education Bureau, Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau, as well as 25 banks participating in the working group, all attended. To further strengthen the banking sector's financing support for Northern Metropolis projects, the Monetary Authority proposed amending the Banking (Capital) Rules to designate government-linked institutions—including 11 post-secondary institutions and 3 park companies—as 'local public sector entities', which would help lower banks' cost of funds and facilitate these institutions in obtaining bank financing, thereby accelerating the implementation of Northern Metropolis projects. The Monetary Authority plans to submit the relevant amendment to the Legislative Council in the first quarter of next year, aiming for it to take effect in the second quarter. The Education Bureau presented the latest developments on the Northern Metropolis University Town at the meeting, including the positioning of the 3 university towns, campus area development, and related financial arrangements. Attendees discussed and provided professional advice on feasible financing arrangements for the Northern Metropolis University Town, such as loans and public-private partnerships. Banks participating in the working group said they would provide suitable financial services to support the coordinated development of the Northern Metropolis University Town with surrounding industrial parks and projects.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong's Monetary Authority and the Banking Association held a meeting about financing for the Northern Metropolis, a major development zone, focusing on how to help universities and business parks there get bank loans more easily, including plans for a new 'university town'.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】黃仁勳真是被精液沖昏頭腦？
articles.summary: 輝達老闆黃仁勳出軌嘅情人黃樂，佢間公司俾人懷疑幫中國走私晶片，搞到輝達股價大跌。

levels.text: 輝達嘅黃仁勳認咗出軌，情人係黃樂。他們在台北酒吧認識，後來黃樂的公司被指和中國有關。有人話佢哋仲走私晶片去中國添。消息一出，輝達股價就下跌了好多，市值蒸發咗好幾百億美元。
levels.text_en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair, with the other person being Huang Le. They met at a bar in Taipei, and later Huang Le's company was said to be connected to China. Some people say they even smuggled chips to China. After the news broke, Nvidia's stock price fell a lot, and its market value evaporated by several hundred billion dollars.

levels.text: 輝達行政總裁黃仁勳承認對妻子不忠，對象是中國女子黃樂。兩人在台北酒吧認識後，黃樂的公司Megaspeed被指和中國政府有關聯，可能協助走私輝達晶片到中國，規避美國出口管制。這消息傳出後，輝達股價大跌，市值蒸發超過二千億美元。有報道指，黃樂原本是中國遊戲公司第七大道的人馬，後來透過空殼公司掩飾股權，最終順利取得輝達認證成為合作夥伴。
levels.text_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, with the other party being a Chinese woman named Huang Le. After the two met at a bar in Taipei, Huang Le's company Megaspeed was alleged to be linked to the Chinese government, possibly helping smuggle Nvidia chips to China to evade US export controls. After this news came out, Nvidia's stock price plunged, and its market value evaporated by more than $200 billion. According to reports, Huang Le was originally connected to the Chinese gaming company 7Road (Di Qi Dadao), and later used shell companies to disguise ownership, eventually successfully obtaining Nvidia certification to become a partner.

levels.text: 人類史上最窮奢極侈的一次出軌，毫無疑問，就是輝達CEO黃仁勳偷吃「女共諜」黃樂了。自黃仁勳承認對妻子不忠後，輝達股價盤前一度插水近5%，市值一下子蒸發二千億美元，「也許就因為要成全她」——那個一夜成名的大陸女子黃樂（Alice Huang）。 一般人出軌是不值得評論的，但黃仁勳不是一般人。誰握住他的春袋，誰就握住全球科技命脈，足以影響美、中國力競爭。女主角黃樂，雖不像古希臘海倫，擁有「使千艘戰艦齊發的容貌」，但絕對有偷運十萬顆晶片的手段。黃仁勳出軌，若僅僅是對妻子不忠，「犯了全天下男人都會犯的錯」，公眾當然不必置喙。我最怕是沒這樣簡單。 黃仁勳跟黃樂的關係，很多人都追溯到2024年6月某夜台北酒吧的一幕。黃樂以新加坡公司Megaspeed高管的身分，跟一群科技業主管在酒吧聚會。據在場的軟體供應商NetThunder行政總裁Parker Schmitt所述，黃樂誇口說：「跟你們打賭，我能把黃仁勳叫來。」不一會，黃仁勳果然穿着他的招牌黑皮衣現身，和眾人一起喝威士忌。NetThunder隨後將黃仁勳、黃樂等人的合照發布於LinkedIn。 以上耐人尋味的故事，其實不是今天才有的新聞，早見於去年10月《紐約時報》刊出的報道〈A Mystery C.E.O. and Billions in Sales: Is China Buying Banned Nvidia Chips?〉。當時記者更翻查了馬來西亞貿易紀錄，指出那次台北酒吧聚會後幾星期內，Megaspeed就開始穩定接收價值數以百萬美元計的輝達最先進晶片。 然而再看真一點，輝達跟Megaspeed的合作，早於2023年已悄悄展開。Megaspeed表面上是新加坡公司，實際上跟中共有千絲萬縷關係——它的前身，就是中国網絡遊戲公司「第七大道（7Road）」，股東包括中共中央政府及多個地方政府。2022年10月，拜登政府開始實施晶片出口管制；五個月後，第七大道就將旗下的新加坡業務分拆，出售予黃樂控制的海外公司Huang Le Ltd.，並更名為Megaspeed。黃樂出任董事總經理，另一名董事叫Cang Yang。 2023年11月，Huang Le Ltd.將Megaspeed 全部股權轉讓給新成立的新加坡空殼公司 Swiftdata，黃樂和Cang Yang辭任董事。這家Swiftdata的唯一股東及Megaspeed的唯一董事，叫Tan Yong Pong（Tan應該是姓陳），又名James Tan，是一名五十多歲、常駐上海的新加坡籍男子，背景神秘。股權轉讓僅四天後，Megaspeed便獲輝達正式認證為Nvidia Cloud Partner。由此可見，黃樂應該在2023年已搭上黃仁勳，同時布局金蟬脫殼，把Megaspeed股權轉給一個明顯只掛名的James Tan。 2024年2月，Megaspeed在馬來西亞
levels.text_en: Without a doubt, the most extravagantly excessive affair in human history is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's infidelity with the 'female Chinese spy' Huang Le. Since Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, Nvidia's pre-market stock price plunged nearly 5% at one point, wiping out $200 billion in market value in an instant — 'perhaps all for her sake' — the mainland Chinese woman Huang Le (Alice Huang) who became famous overnight. Ordinary people's affairs aren't worth commenting on, but Jensen Huang is no ordinary person. Whoever holds his 'spring bag' holds the lifeline of global technology, enough to affect the US-China power rivalry. The female lead, Huang Le, may not have Helen of Troy's 'face that launched a thousand ships,' but she absolutely has the means to smuggle out a hundred thousand chips. If Jensen Huang's affair were merely infidelity to his wife, 'a mistake all men in the world make,' the public naturally wouldn't need to comment. What I fear most is that it's not that simple. Many people trace Jensen Huang's relationship with Huang Le back to a scene one night in June 2024 at a bar in Taipei. Huang Le, in her capacity as an executive of the Singapore company Megaspeed, was partying with a group of tech industry executives at the bar. According to Parker Schmitt, CEO of software vendor NetThunder who was present, Huang Le boasted: 'I bet you I can get Jensen Huang to come here.' Not long after, Jensen Huang indeed showed up wearing his signature black leather jacket, and drank whiskey with everyone. NetThunder later posted a group photo of Jensen Huang, Huang Le and others on LinkedIn. This intriguing story is actually not news that broke today — it was already reported last October in a New York Times article titled 'A Mystery C.E.O. and Billions in Sales: Is China Buying Banned Nvidia Chips?' At the time, the reporter had checked Malaysian trade records and pointed out that within weeks of that Taipei bar gathering, Megaspeed began steadily receiving Nvidia's most advanced chips worth millions of dollars. However, looking more closely, Nvidia's cooperation with Megaspeed had quietly begun as early as 2023. Megaspeed is ostensibly a Singapore company, but in reality has deep ties to the Chinese Communist Party — its predecessor was the Chinese online gaming company '7Road,' whose shareholders included the CCP central government and several local governments. In October 2022, the Biden administration began implementing chip export controls; five months later, 7Road spun off its Singapore business and sold it to Huang Le's offshore company, Huang Le Ltd., renaming it Megaspeed. Huang Le became managing director, with another director named Cang Yang. In November 2023, Huang Le Ltd. transferred all of Megaspeed's equity to a newly established Singapore shell company called Swiftdata, and Huang Le and Cang Yang resigned as directors. The sole shareholder of Swiftdata and sole director of Megaspeed is a man named Tan Yong Pong (Tan is likely the surname), also known as James Tan, a Singaporean man in his fifties based in Shanghai, with a mysterious background. Just four days after the equity transfer, Megaspeed was officially certified by Nvidia as an Nvidia Cloud Partner. This shows that Huang Le likely already got involved with Jensen Huang in 2023, while simultaneously arranging a 'cicada shedding its shell' scheme — transferring Megaspeed's equity to the clearly nominal James Tan.
